name: Satou Yuuta
source:
Skinny and with a childish face, he is often mistaken for an elementary school student.

Although he still has phimosis, he has a strong erection and ejaculates frequently in large quantities.

Separated from his mother at an early age, and his older brother moving out, and father away for work, he practically lives alone.

His hobby is reading.
